description: Permissions for the main window. The header drags the window and the window's theme follows the app's color scheme. The opener may open only GitHub pages, such as a batch's pull request, OpenAI's sign-in page, which Connect opens for a ChatGPT plan account, Artificial Analysis's site, which the credit beside its scores links, and `http` pages on loopback hosts (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1] and names under .localhost, any port), which the window opens only for the selected project's own app address. The dialog may open the folder panel.
